newsitem.title: USA: U.S. FERC extends deadline for utility info system.
newsitem.headline: U.S. FERC extends deadline for utility info system.

text.p: The U.S. Federal Energy Regulatory Commission gave a two-month extension for electric utilities to begin operating electronic systems to provide all transmission users access to information on grid capacity at the same time.

In an order issued late Friday, the commission granted a request from an industry working group for a two-step postponement from November 1, calling for test operations of the open access same-time information system (OASIS) to begin on December 2, and full commercial operations by January 3.

OASIS is intended to promote power market competition, by giving all power producers and marketers access to the same information on generation and transmission capacity at the same time as utilities tell their affiliates.
